rv.q: Caroline Loncq as his breezily tolerant wife sums up one theme of this overwhelmingly moving play when she says of life that "you draw your cards face down, you turn them over and you do your best with the hand you've got".
Broken Glass is a rich and deeply-felt drama - and one that richly deserves to thrive.
This is one of Sher's finest performances, as the self-imposed bonds keeping him so constricted twang under ever greater strain until they finally burst asunder.

cn.t: Critics praise this challenging 1994 Miller work as a standout in the West End, with Sher and FitzGerald delivering outstanding performances in a production that towers over contemporary theater.
